title: Practice 1: Running, swimming, climbing, crawling, dragging

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: A rabbit is running in the garden.
exercises.why: **бегает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).

exercises.q: Can chimpanzees swim?
exercises.why: **плавать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).
